Package index

VCF

Functions operating on VCF files

vcf2dist()
Calculate distances between samples of a VCF file
vcf2tree()
Generate phylogenetic tree from samples of a VCF file
vcf2istats()
Calculate various per sample statistics from a VCF file
vcf2clusters()
Perform Hierarchical Clustering and tree pruning on samples of VCF file

FASTA

Functions operating on FASTA sequences

fasta2dist()
Calculate distances between sequences of a FASTA file

Distance and tree utilities

dist2tree()
Generate phylogenetic tree from samples of a distance matrix
dist2clusters()
Perform Hierarchical Clustering and tree pruning on a distance matrix
tree2clusters()
Perform Hierarchical Clustering and tree pruning on a phylogenetic tree

Package

fastreeR fastreeR-package
fastreeR: Phylogenetic, Distance and Other Calculations on VCF and Fasta Files
